A leaf's dependency_boundary must be read as a scope statement and then measured against the repository, because 'deterministic/partly owned' does not say which part is owned. A claim_scope that excludes most of a module is not verification of the module, so an excluded scope must be closed rather than left standing. The previous finding verified the losslessness, byte-accounting, admission and lower-bound core of canonical/runtime/source_contract_compiler.py and explicitly excluded validate_contract_coverage (about 110 lines) and validate_semantic_consensus (about 157 lines), roughly 267 of the module's 432 lines and 40 of its 51 error tokens. When the project itself computes an exact next cut, the most leveraged zero-spend action is to execute the verification-shaped items of that cut rather than to keep verifying peripheral modules, and to re-measure the terminal state from the project's own authority mechanism instead of trusting any earlier measurement. A pinned dependency cone is only a guarantee if the pins are recomputed independently, and a claim of independent verification is only a guarantee if the attestation artifacts are opened, so both must be measured rather than read off a manifest field. The previous entry read SA_CCR's claim strength from the manifest's executor_status wording alone, which said PREFLIGHT_PASS, and it verified the CAD cone with the git binary rather than with an independent hash implementation; the multiplex module's seven governance bindings had not been checked at all, and the cause of the CAD route's seven test failures had been characterized only as absent third-party packages without resolving which one was truly last.

A launch-authority PASS derived by one reducer cannot be read as terminal readiness while other owned validators fail closed, so every red on the terminal test surface must be decomposed to a root cause rather than counted. Current main carries 139 workflows and 51 test modules on the terminal surface; the wave launch authority reducer derives launch_authority true, yet the terminal route execution plan validator derives launch_authority false on the same tree, and several workflow-watched prewave verifiers fail closed. A diagnosis is only actionable if it names the exact key, the exact file and the exact replacement value, together with the order in which the edits must be applied, because re-pinning a blob that another edit is about to change produces a second drift.
